## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick up the portable curved handle fan and set it on the Pink mat facing the robot.

Task description: Place the portable fan with a curved handle at the front right of the table on the pink square mat to its right, standing upright with its face toward the robot.

Success criteria: The fan is placed near the center of the pink square mat, with its base resting on the mat, body upright, and fan face toward the robot. Both grippers are open and have released it.

## Execution tips

- When gripping the curved handle, choose a section with clearance from the fan housing, low curvature, and enough room for the pads. Avoid the joint and smooth ends to reduce interference and slipping.
- Set the gripper opening slightly wider than the grasp area. Before closing, use the visible gap to confirm that the fingers are on opposite sides, avoiding mere image overlap or accidentally grasping the protective grille.
- When adjusting orientation, rotate it off the table where there is clearance, watching the sweep of the circular fan guard and bottom support. Avoid scraping the table or pushing the adjacent square mat.
- During placement, let the base rest steadily on the mat and confirm the body is no longer tilted before release, avoiding a tip caused by the fan guard contacting first.
